core_meaning.primary_meaning: Ma is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Water”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ma corresponds to the Arabic form ماء (Arabic root م و ه (m-w-h); مَاء (Māʾ)). Its core sense is water. Ma is Arabic مَاء (Māʾ) 'water', from the root م و ه (m-w-h). hindi.name: मा
